tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Paper — page and card surface; the base every text pairing is checked on. Dark value is proposed.

tokens.name: paper-deep
tokens.usage: Proposed. Sunken surfaces: the desktop sample-notebook panel and skeleton rows. ink, graphite and moss text all pass AA on it in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Proposed. Decorative lines only: card outline, the "or" divider, notebook rules. Never the only boundary of a control — use rule for that.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Ink — headings and body text on paper, paper-deep, moss-soft and error-soft. 16.1:1 on paper (light), 15.6:1 (dark).

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Graphite — secondary text: helper text, placeholders, the footer terms line. 6.3:1 on paper (light), 8.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Rule — field and secondary-button outlines. 3.4:1 on paper (light), 4.1:1 (dark): meets the 3:1 non-text floor. Not for text.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Moss (primary) — primary button fill, links, focus ring, selected picker row. As text: 7.0:1 on paper (light), 9.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moss fill (the primary button label). White on moss 7.5:1; the dark theme's light moss takes dark text (8.5:1).

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Proposed. Tinted ground behind success and info messages and the hovered picker row; moss or ink text on it.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon, always paired with a word and an icon. 6.1:1 on paper (light), 8.2:1 (dark).

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Proposed. Ground behind an error message; error or ink text on it (5.6:1 / 7.0:1).

tokens.name: highlighter
tokens.usage: Highlighter (accent) — highlight marks only, behind on-highlighter text (10.9:1). NEVER white text on it (1.6:1, fails). Never a button or link.

tokens.name: on-highlighter
tokens.usage: Text inside a highlight mark, in every theme (ink's light value, so the dark theme keeps dark text on yellow).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: The 2px focus outline on every control — an alias of moss.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links (Terms, Privacy Policy, Request your institution) — an alias of moss, underlined.

styles.name: heading-xl

styles.usage: Proposed. Desktop screen heading beside the sample panel.

styles.name: heading-lg
styles.sample: Your research notes, in one place
styles.usage: Proposed. Screen heading on mobile and inside the 440px card.

styles.name: heading-sm
styles.usage: Proposed. Section headings inside a notebook.

styles.name: note-quote
styles.sample: Surface temperatures in dense cores ran 4–6 °C above the rural fringe.
styles.usage: Proposed. Quoted passages and highlights in a notebook.

styles.name: note-body
styles.sample: Reading notes sit beside their sources.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Free for students and researchers at 1,200+ institutions
styles.usage: Proposed. Subheads, field values, messages. 16px keeps iOS from zooming inputs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Proposed. Button labels and field labels.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: By continuing, you agree to Fieldnote's Terms and Privacy Policy.
styles.usage: Proposed. Helper text, picker domains, the footer terms line, citations.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Proposed. The "or" divider and small metadata.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside small labels.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field; icon to text in buttons and alerts.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked buttons; picker row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field padding; mobile side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between groups (buttons → divider → email).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Heading block to form; card to sample panel.

radius.note: Proposed: modest corners for an editorial, paper-like feel.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Highlight marks and skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, fields, the picker list, alerts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The sign-up card and the sample-notebook panel.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target, from the brief (WCAG 2.2).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Proposed. Buttons, fields and picker rows — above the 44px floor.

tokens.name: focus-width
tokens.usage: The visible Moss focus ring, from the brief.

tokens.name: card-width
tokens.usage: The centered desktop sign-up card, from the brief.
